evidence.sentence: We are no longer accepting applications for the Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships.
Please refer to the Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Doctoral program web page for information regarding the new harmonized program.

closures.replacement: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship - Doctoral program

source: Driven by the data-quality checker's closure findings (scripts/check_data_quality.py RESOLUTIONS). Each entry is one programme the corpus itself says is closed, with the verbatim evidence sentences from the chunk named. app/eligibility.py reads this file at load time and validates every evidence sentence verbatim against the chunk text, exactly like the eligibility rules: an entry whose evidence is not found is dropped with a warning and the programme is treated as open, so a closure can never survive a re-ingest that removed it. Add a new closed programme by adding one entry here and the matching RESOLUTIONS entry in the checker — never by editing app/eligibility.py.
